title: ⚡️ Microsoft STRIKES with Phi 1.5 - SMALL but STRONG!!!
author: fisj

comments.author: fisj
comments.body:
1.3B model, with very high performance in reasoning and code in comparison to larger models (7-13B). Research license only for now, but this model was built on the 'textbooks are all you need' methodology detailed in the paper. In short, researchers are developing clever ways to structure training data to get the best results in smaller and smaller models.

If games are ever to run locally, we need small but powerful models like this. This research and model is exciting.
